parts.problem_md:
Figure 3.1 shows the world population pyramid in 2023.

![2023 world population pyramid showing the percentage of males (left) and females (right) in each five-year age group from 0-4 to 100+.](assets/001-2023-world-population-pyramid-showing-the-percen.png)

*Figure 3.1 PopulationPyramid.net, CC BY 3.0 IGO*

Use Figure 3.1 to compare the world population of males to the world population of females in 2023.
parts.solution_md:
Overall, the pyramid has a similar shape for males and females  **[1 mark]**. There are more males than females in every age group from 0-4 to 45-49, for example 4.4% males compared with 4.1% females aged 5-9  **[1 mark]**. Over the age of 55, there are fewer males than females, for example 0.8% males compared with 1.0% females aged 75-79  **[1 mark]**.

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **Mark allocation**
> 
> This answer is assessed using a point-marked approach.
> 
> - **One mark** for an overall comparison
> - **One mark** each for any two further comparisons, to a maximum of 3 marks
> - Every point must compare males with females
> 
> **Alternative content**
> 
> The answer above is just one example of how to respond to this question. Other information that could be used includes:
> 
> - The 50-54 age group has the same percentage of males and females (2.8%)
> - More males are born than females, shown by the wider male bar for 0-4
> - Any other suitable response
> 
> **Common errors**
> 
> - Quoting figures from the pyramid without saying which is bigger or smaller

> **[exam-tip]**
> - Use comparative words such as 'more than', 'fewer than' or 'the same as' in every sentence, and back each one with a pair of figures.

parts.problem_md:
Figure 3.1 shows the world population pyramid in 2023.

![2023 world population pyramid showing the percentage of males (left) and females (right) in each five-year age group from 0-4 to 100+.](assets/001-2023-world-population-pyramid-showing-the-percen.png)

*Figure 3.1 PopulationPyramid.net, CC BY 3.0 IGO*

Suggest why the percentage values in the pyramid in Figure 3.1 do not total 100%.
parts.solution_md:
**The values have been rounded to one decimal place**  **[1 mark]**

> **[exam-tip]**
> - Do not say someone made an error in adding up, because that answer gets no credit. Small age groups, such as 100+, can show 0.0% even though people are in them because the real value has been rounded down.

parts.problem_md:
Figure 3.1 shows the world population pyramid in 2023.

![2023 world population pyramid showing the percentage of males (left) and females (right) in each five-year age group from 0-4 to 100+.](assets/001-2023-world-population-pyramid-showing-the-percen.png)

*Figure 3.1 PopulationPyramid.net, CC BY 3.0 IGO*

State the percentage of the world population that is over 74 years of age in 2023.
parts.solution_md:
Males aged 75 and over: 0.8 + 0.4 + 0.2 + 0.1 = 1.5%

Females aged 75 and over: 1.0 + 0.6 + 0.4 + 0.2 = 2.2%

Total: 1.5 + 2.2 = **3.7%**  **[1 mark]**

> **[exam-tip]**
> - Over 74 means every age group from 75-79 upwards. Remember to add the male and female bars together.
